question:
The monthly production of electric bulbs by a company during the second half of the year 2021 is shown by the following

bar graph. Study the bar graph carefully and answer the question given below.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb8b5dd327d09ba549aedf7c3929204a9e8fdcdd12e039f4fec858ccc47c6aa6.png] 

What is the percentage decrement in the production of electric bulbs in October as compared to the production in July?

(Correct up to two decimal places.)
solution:
**Calculation:**

The production of electric bulbs in October = 375

The production of electric bulbs in October = 550

According to the question,

⇒ (550 - 375)/550 × 100

⇒ 31.82%

**∴ The correct answer is 31.82%**
